title: Guild Wars 2
provenance: AppleGamingWiki rates it Perfect through CrossOver and through Wine, with reports from an M2 Mac mini (Game Porting Toolkit with Whisky, 100 to 140 fps at low settings) and an M4 Max (CrossOver, 80 to 120 fps at 4K high). Measured here on an M4 with macOS 27.0 on 2026-10-01, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17 with DXMT and msync. The Steam copy's launcher renders, shows the game fully downloaded (Playable, Ready) and reaches the ArenaNet display-name step. The game itself was not started here. chiqors (highball-db#480, 2026-10-14), Apple M5 16 GB, Highball 0.10.5, DXMT, the game's balanced preset, rated 4 of 5 with occasional frame drops. Not verified by the maintainer. AmarokSpiritch (highball-db#1090, 2026-11-08), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 33 minutes: with the environment set to Windows 11.
notes: Free to play on Steam, about 90 GB. Its launcher opens on Highball's default setup and, on a first start, asks for an ArenaNet display name to link to your Steam account before the game starts. Only the launcher was exercised here, so no frame rate was measured. AppleGamingWiki's Wine entry says to turn esync off. Highball uses msync, a different mechanism. If the game hangs, set the environment's Synchronization to None. Checked here on 2026-10-05 on an M4 with engine r21 in DXMT mode: the launcher reaches Ready and asks for a display name at 120 s; the game itself was not entered. A player on an M5 with 16 GB plays it on DXMT with the game's balanced preset, with occasional frame drops (highball-db#480).
